scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Arturo’s Monday adaptive-reader orientation usable by ensuring the library-card barcode required for device preloading is supplied before the preload cutoff.
Emerging Need: The outing is tentative at first; once the seat is confirmed, the future session lacks a prerequisite but no check-in or device checkout has begun.
Decision Context: The desk contact and library notices establish the official route, roster status, and deadline, while a stored coordination note supplies Arturo’s permitted barcode wording and privacy limits.
Consequence: Timely coordination can let staff tag a reader for the appointment; after preload closes, the session can proceed only as observation.

parameter.subject: Seat confirmed: Monday adaptive-reader orientation
parameter.body: Arturo Wynn has a confirmed seat for Monday at 10:00 a.m. The roster still shows a blank library-card barcode, which is required before staff can preload and tag an adaptive reader for his hands-on session. Barcode updates for Monday preloads close today at 3:00 p.m.

parameter.subject: Monday adaptive-reader preload window closed
parameter.body: The 3:00 p.m. preload window for Monday adaptive-reader appointments has closed. Records without a library-card barcode will not have a tagged reader ready for hands-on use; barcode changes received after closure move to the July orientation waitlist.
